verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduled jobs are a fair axis for an email service, but the evidence only shows one-off timed actions: Scheduled Send for a single message and Snooze for returning a message at a set time. Filters & Rules run when mail arrives, not on a recurring schedule. Nothing in the pack documents recurring jobs, cron-like workflows, or repeating automation, so one-off scheduling cannot stand in for a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
